BiblicalUsage: Malachi is the prophet whose name stands at the head of the last book of the Old Testament, in Malachi 1:1, where the burden of the word of the LORD to Israel comes by Malachi. His name means my messenger, and he is the last voice of the Old Testament before the silence.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Malachi's place at the end is no accident: his is the last voice before four hundred years of silence, and then the voice in the wilderness.
